method: Zhang et al. 2022 Section 2.5, downscaled sampling ablation
normalization: preserve sampled N2; proportionally normalize all other log-sampled weights to 1-N2
hrr_filter_reason: No HRR rejection threshold is specified in Section 2.5
negative_HRR_policy: retained when the Cantera state/label is admissible; HRR sign alone is not a rejection criterion
label_admissibility: finite Cantera results, negative Y only within solver roundoff, target T within existing 200-6000 K model domain
fidelity_exceptions: 9-species/28-reaction existing mechanism instead of 8-species/16-reaction paper mechanism
explicit N2-preserving simplex normalization; Section 2.5 does not specify normalization details
